review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines named aliases (machinePairFirst/Second, which wrap Cobham.fstBlock/sndBlock from Complexitylib). It then defines further aliases for matrix, list and rational-entry roles, with FP-membership and encode simp lemmas. The aliases are in the same project, not Mathlib, and each one is a different role-specific name over the same function. The rubric treats named specialisations as acceptable. The underlying concepts here are project-specific: Complexity.pair codes, FP, and the binary encodings. I know of no Mathlib counterpart for them. The only Mathlib notion used is Nat.bits, which the file uses directly and does not redefine. I did not search Mathlib for a competing pair-code or FP notion, so that part rests on my knowledge. Nothing here is a competing reimplementation of a Mathlib concept, so I abstain.
